s1.syndrome_frame: Widespread skin condition with progressive worsening and characteristic plaques
salient_findings: Widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques with a double-edged scale
key_facts: Patient is a 32-year-old woman
Skin condition has progressively worsened
Condition involves 90% of body surface area
Plaques are present on the trunk and extremities
Skin biopsy shows psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis
Trichography shows nodal swelling with invagination of the distal hair into the proximal end
Eyebrow hairs are sparse and less than 5 mm long
Scalp hairs are coarse and brittle

key_facts: Patient is a 32-year-old woman
Skin condition has progressively worsened
Condition involves 90% of body surface area
Plaques are present on the trunk and extremities
Skin biopsy shows psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis
Trichography shows nodal swelling with invagination of the distal hair into the proximal end
Eyebrow hairs are sparse and less than 5 mm long
Scalp hairs are coarse and brittle

differentials: Congenital hemidysplasia with ichthyosiform erythroderma and limb defects
Keratosis linearis with ichthyosis congenita and sclerosing keratoderma
per_call: Congenital hemidysplasia with ichthyosiform erythroderma and limb defects
Keratosis linearis with ichthyosis congenita and sclerosing keratoderma

shortlist.label: Netherton syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Characteristic skin and hair findings, including psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia and trichorrhexis invaginata

shortlist.label: Pityriasis rubra pilaris
shortlist.why_kept: Widespread skin involvement with erythematous plaques and double-edged scale

shortlist.label: Ichthyosis linearis circumflexa
shortlist.why_kept: Similar skin findings, including erythematous plaques and scaling

shortlist.label: Atopic dermatitis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic skin condition with progressive worsening and skin biopsy showing spongiosis

shortlist.label: Psoriasis vulgaris
shortlist.why_kept: Psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia on skin biopsy and presence of erythematous plaques

raw.rationale: The combination of skin findings, including psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis, and hair abnormalities such as nodal swelling and invagination of the distal hair into the proximal end, along with sparse and short eyebrow hairs and coarse brittle scalp hairs, are characteristic of Netherton syndrome.

rejected.label: Pityriasis rubra pilaris
rejected.why: While it can cause widespread skin involvement, the specific hair findings and skin biopsy results are more consistent with Netherton syndrome.

rejected.label: Ichthyosis linearis circumflexa
rejected.why: This condition is often associated with Netherton syndrome but on its own does not account for the full spectrum of the patient's symptoms, particularly the hair abnormalities.

rejected.label: Atopic dermatitis
rejected.why: The presence of psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia and specific hair findings are not typical for atopic dermatitis, which usually presents with different clinical and histological features.

rejected.label: Psoriasis vulgaris
rejected.why: While the skin biopsy shows psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia, the overall clinical picture including the hair abnormalities and the specific pattern of skin involvement is more suggestive of Netherton syndrome than psoriasis vulgaris.
